decisions.ci: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs npm test on push and PR (mirrors gta-shooter-web-app)
decisions.pagination: one request per (origin, weekend) WITHOUT limit; abort the snapshot if nextPage != null (do not send limit)
decisions.maxTotalSourceOfTruth: snapshot capped server-side (priceValueTo=100) and re-checked in core/deals.js; the UI max-price filter can only lower it

acceptanceCriteria: Only deals with outbound Friday, inbound following Monday, totalPrice <= 100 EUR are shown (snapshot capped server-side and re-checked in core/deals.js; the UI max-price filter can only lower the cap)
Origin defaults to ATH; the origin selector offers exactly the origins present in the snapshot and changing it changes results
Max-price filter (default 100) and destination search work; results sorted by total ascending
Filter state is encoded in the URL and restored on reload
Each deal shows route, city names, dates, times, flight numbers, per-leg and total EUR price
No runtime third-party network calls; only same-origin data/deals.json is fetched
node --test test/ passes on Node 18 and core/* modules are DOM-free
fetch-deals.mjs omits limit, aborts on a non-null nextPage, and has an offline fixture test (complete page, empty fares, non-null nextPage abort)
package.json and .github/workflows/ci.yml match the gta/pacman house conventions; CI runs on push and PR
Site works when served statically from GitHub Pages using relative paths
README and AGENTS.md document local run, tests and data refresh
